title: RISK ASSESSMENT AND SECURITY ANALYSIS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating semantic cosine similarity between occupational word vectors (e.g., 'nurse', 'engineer') and gender labels using a BERT-based transfer learning model, and evaluating automated resume screening scores for female candidates.

Evaluating error rates and text generation quality (BLEU scores) in low-resource African indigenous languages, and quantifying emotional bias values in cross-cultural tasks such as Yoruba kinship inference.

Analyzing systematic emotional bias via negative emotion labeling probabilities for minority groups and comparing model misdiagnosis rates for African American patients versus white patients in medical diagnosis scenarios.
